pos.personaBrief: At Barcelona (61% possession in the 2015 final) and PSG ('we prefer to get the ball, keep the ball') the team is built on having the ball and securing it with five outside players around the block, so he does not cede it to counter.

pro.personaBrief: Plays out through the goalkeeper to create superiority even against pressing (Sports Mole, Coaches' Voice), but with a vertical edge: direct verticality from centre-back or full-back, long balls to the wings, calm possession turning into full-throttle attack.

est.personaBrief: Juego de posición 2.0 with 5 inside, 5 outside, but with rotations, forwards dropping, and no fixed individual reference (CulturePSG), wingers both wide and cutting inside, no defined centre-forward in the final.

lar.personaBrief: Uses orthodox wide forwards who hold width and drag markers (Kvaratskhelia, MSN), full-backs giving width, and attacks the wide areas first; wide players are also able to cut inside, and the plan is to stretch the block.

blo.personaBrief: PSG presses player-to-player against build-up, front line leads the press, swarming after loss (Coaches' Voice final, Sports Mole); Barcelona also pressed Juventus; defends high with Pacho and Marquinhos stepping out to duel.

mar.personaBrief: Open-play press is player-to-player, Barcelona switched set pieces from zonal to man, PSG uses mixed zone at set pieces and abandoned a partial zonal system; Spain used mid-block 4-1-4-1 (excluded).

pla.personaBrief: Strong identity ('tenemos muy clara la idea y no la vamos a cambiar'), imposes his model on arrival, though he admits adapting and defending better against stronger sides in 2026.

res.personaBrief: 'Lo que menos me preocupa es el resultado'; teams keep attacking when ahead (menorca) and play for the win, valuing the way (juego de ataque) even while winning trophies.

sis.personaBrief: 'Stars are in function of the team, not the other way round'; effort over ego, Dembele benched for lateness, everyone presses, a system with rotations and players interchangeable; but stars like Messi/MSN had freedom at Barcelona.

jog.personaBrief: Wants technical, ball-playing players who also run and press with high intensity; midfielders like Vitinha and Pedri-type profiles, deep passers, and everyone participates in defence, so no room for non-running 10s.

bas.personaBrief: Builds with signings (Rakitic, Kvaratskhelia, Neves) and a young squad, but not from an academy-first view; titles with young players in key roles.

lid.personaBrief: Iron fist: fines for minutes of lateness, Dembele dropped for being late ('best decision of the season'), clash with Messi; same rules for stars, relaxed somewhat at Barcelona but remains the boss.
